lines.text: This was Earth's tallest building for thirty-eight hundred years.
lines.caption: This was Earth's tallest building for 3,800 years.

lines.text: And what finally beat it is even stranger.
Built about forty-five hundred years ago, the Great Pyramid stood about one hundred forty-six meters tall.
lines.caption: Built about 4,500 years ago, the Great Pyramid stood about 146 meters tall.

lines.text: Empires rose and fell. For thousands of years, nothing got taller.
Then, in thirteen eleven, a church spire in England finally beat it.
lines.caption: Then, in 1311, a church spire in England finally beat it.

lines.text: But a storm knocked that spire down in fifteen forty-eight.
lines.caption: But a storm knocked that spire down in 1548.
